policy: Compare the immutable EAN attached to each canonically usable Mercadona OCR product_id with a fresh official first-party product-detail observation. A different current EAN proves product_id reuse/reassignment and is reported only as an identity hazard; this audit never mutates historical canonical OCR nutrition. An explicit HTTP 404 is recorded separately as CURRENT_PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND: it proves that the current product-detail endpoint does not expose that id at audit time, but it does not prove reassignment. Missing/unavailable current identity fails closed and remains unresolved.
